title: Pad Y/B opens an invisible settings panel at Game_Over and steals the A-retry
detail: The panel gate precedes the Game_Over guard, but draw_hud's game-over branch returns before the chip/panel draw. Pad Y/B at Game_Over opens an invisible modal; pad A then adjusts and persists settings instead of retrying.
recommended_fix: Move the panel_open gate below the Game_Over block (matching touch_map's ordering), or reject Toggle_Settings and Settings_* intents when mode == Game_Over in apply_intent.

title: S cannot close the settings panel while a pipe is selected, contradicting the panel's close hint
evidence:
+			case .S:
+				// 7.3: the panel toggle — collected ONLY with no pipe selected
+				// (with a selection S stays the Standard-lane key; the executor's
+				// Set_Lane sel_pipe gate keeps the paths exclusive).
+				if inp.sel_pipe < 0 {

+				}
+			case .S, .Esc:

+		case .Y:

+	draw_text_c(v, "S / tap chip to close", i32(card.x) + hud(v, 14), i32(card.y) + title_h + hud(v, SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT * 38 + 4), hud(v, 12), p.ink_soft)
detail: Pad Y and the chip open the panel regardless of sel_pipe, but S is collected only when sel_pipe < 0 — with a pipe selected, the advertised 'S to close' key is dead.

title: Health card mixes a raw y=10 anchor with scaled pad/height: backdrop clips above the window and the banner gap drifts
evidence:
+	card_w := hud(v, 440)
+	pad := hud(v, 10)
 	x := (v.win_w - card_w) / 2
 	y := i32(10)
+	rl.DrawRectangle(x - pad, y - pad, card_w + 2 * pad, hud(v, HEALTH_CARD_H), rl.Color{255, 244, 236, 240})
+		return rnd.hud(&app.view, 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6)
detail: pad=hud(10) but y stays raw 10: backdrop top = -3 at x1.25, -5 at x1.50 (clipped off-screen); banner_y=hud(10+H+6) scales the raw anchor too, growing the designed 6px gap to ~23px.
recommended_fix: Anchor the card at scaled y and derive banner_y from the drawn card bottom (y - pad + hud(HEALTH_CARD_H) + gap) instead of hud(10+HEALTH_CARD_H+6).

title: Popover scales width, margins, and demolish-button insets but not its height or title text
detail: Callers pass raw POPOVER_H_* and h is never scaled, yet the demolish button's bottom inset grows to 54px at x1.50 inside the fixed-height card while the title's +10/+8/15 stay raw.
recommended_fix: Scale h via hud_f at the call sites (or inside popover_rect) and scale draw_demolish_popover's title offsets and size to match the button insets.

title: pulse_read is not 'the ONE seam': draw_crisis_outlines inlines its own reduced-motion pin
detail: view.odin declares pulse_read 'the ONE seam every animated pulse consumer routes through', but the crisis outline reads PULSE16 directly and pins factor itself — two mechanisms that can drift apart.
recommended_fix: Compute the outline factor via pulse_read, or correct the seam claim in the comment.

title: keys array grown to 10 slots but the collected set is now 11 keys; overflow drops input silently
evidence:
-	keys: [5]Key
+	keys: [10]Key
 		case .P, .Space:
 			append(out, Intent(Toggle_Pause{}))
 			append(out, Intent(Toggle_Assist{}))
 		case .M:
+			case .Up, .Down, .Left, .Right, .Enter:
+				if keys_n < len(keys) { keys[keys_n] = e.key; keys_n += 1 }
detail: P, Space, the assist key, M, Esc, S, Up, Down, Left, Right, Enter — 11 collectable keys — now fill 10 slots; the bounds guard silently drops the eleventh on a same-frame chord.
recommended_fix: Size the keys array to the collected set (at least 11).

title: demolish_button_rect's nil-view fallback is dead code and an unscaled-divergence trap
detail: Every call site in the diff passes the view, so the nil branch is unreachable; a future caller omitting v gets unscaled insets that diverge from the scaled draw at x1.25+.
recommended_fix: Make v a required parameter and delete the nil fallback branch.

title: step_of and PALETTE_MODE_COUNT have no production callers
evidence:
+// step_of — the nearest step index for a factor (the reverse read for the
+// panel display + save).
+step_of :: proc(scale: f32) -> u8 {
+PALETTE_MODE_COUNT :: 4
+	case SETTINGS_ROW_SCALE:
+		pct := i32(snap.ui_scale * 100 + 0.5)
+		return "UI SCALE", fmt.aprintf("%d%%", pct, allocator = context.temp_allocator)
detail: step_of's stated consumer reads snap.ui_scale directly and saves use scale_step; PALETTE_MODE_COUNT is never referenced — cycle_palette computes Tritan+1 instead. Both are dead in production paths.
recommended_fix: Delete step_of and PALETTE_MODE_COUNT, or wire them into cycle_palette and the panel display/save paths.

title: settings.odin header says '4 bytes' but the format is 6 bytes
evidence:
+// no JSON int/float traps). Version 1: 4 bytes — magic, version, then three
+// u8 values (palette mode 0-3, reduced-motion 0/1, ui-scale step 0-2) + a
+// checksum byte. Load: any mismatch → DEFAULTS + a stderr note (never a
+	buf: [6]u8
detail: Magic + version + three values + checksum = 6 bytes; the code writes, reads, and length-checks 6. The header's 'Version 1: 4 bytes' miscounts its own format.
recommended_fix: Correct the header to say 6 bytes.
